name: Pat
self_text: I'm a Brazilian woman in my 40s who loves playing chess online in my free time. I use a Nikon and I'm looking for a practice session on Sunday morning to work on specific shots at a slow pace. I'd like to take portraits of each other and have someone teach me post-processing, without any gear debates.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available Sunday morning for our photography. I'd strongly prefer that you are okay with a slow pace or a moderate pace, though it's not a requirement.
